person_note: The controlling narration is third person. Goodreads supplies diagnostic external narration and free-indirect access in q09156, q09169, and q09172; first-person forms elsewhere occur in speeches or other local material, and generic you passages are not second-person storytelling. The authorized interior excerpt independently sustains third-person narration, while chapter-tagged study-guide passages corroborate the same mode across the book through Chapter 93. No research uncovered a first-person frame or sustained alternate-person section. The main limitation is that no source explicitly names the whole-book POV, but the mutually consistent authorized prose, book-wide samples, and quote evidence make the classification high confidence.
